purpose: Measure finite-shot training and terminal-certificate scaling for parameter-matched MERA and MPS without budget-specific retuning.
checkpoint_rule: Save the first completed SPSA step whose cumulative training-shot count is greater than or equal to the requested budget; report both requested and achieved counts.

statistics.paired_comparison: MERA_PM225 minus MPS within each field-replicate-budget cell
statistics.reason_for_97_5_percent: Bonferroni-compatible reporting for the manuscript's two primary architecture comparisons.
statistics.bootstrap_method: paired percentile bootstrap within each fixed field, followed by an equal-weight average across the three fields

estimand: Equal-field-weight average paired optimizer-seed performance over the three fixed TFIM fields h/J in {0.9,1.0,1.1}; it does not represent arbitrary-field generalization.

seed_policy.description: Equal-coordinate MERA_PM225 and MPS runs in a field-replicate cell use the same initial vector, SPSA directions, and measurement seed labels.

resource_accounting.abstract_gate_unit: one physical SU(4) block application to one state preparation

guardrails: No optimizer, stage, field, architecture, replicate, checkpoint, or endpoint may be changed after the first scientific result is inspected.
The lower-budget results are checkpoints from the same trajectory that reaches 560 million shots; no budget receives separate tuning.
Exact fidelity and held-out observables are simulation-only oracle diagnostics.
Training-shot and certification-shot budgets are reported separately.
MERA_PM225 versus MPS is parameter matched, not gate matched; physical gate exposure is reported explicitly.
The fixed fields are design points, not a random sample of the TFIM field axis.
A failed seed or field is reported as-is and is not rerun with altered settings.
